author: UFC / Zuffa LLC official fighter portrait (served by the ESPN CDN; photographer not named)
notes: Studio front headshot, shirtless, neutral expression, white background. Uploaded in UFC Vegas 118 fight week (June 2026), so the most recent frontal face. Best reference for the face shape, eyes, nose and beard.

author: UFC / Zuffa LLC official fighter portrait (served by the ESPN CDN; photographer not named)
notes: Studio full body with a slight three-quarter turn, green UFC shorts with a dark-green leaf print, black gloves. June 2026. Best physique reference; shows the dense body hair.

author: UFC / Zuffa LLC official fighter portrait (served by the ESPN CDN; photographer not named)
notes: Studio full body from UFC 304 fight week (July 2024): green Venum-era UFC shorts with white diagonal stripes on his left hip, gold gloves. Leaner and more defined than June 2026.

author: Inaquout (Wikimedia Commons user; 'own work')
attribution: Photo by Inaquout, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
notes: Casual gym photo, grey T-shirt, red shorts; three-quarter face turned to his left, smiling with the mouth slightly open. Phone photo, bright and slightly overexposed, so skin reads paler than it is. Shows the beard texture and his right ear. The only freely licensed photo of him; the Commons 'Belal Muhammad delivering speech' files show a different person (a Bangladeshi speaker, 2012) and were not used.

author: UFC (credit as given by Fight Mag)
notes: Outdoor face-off with Jack Della Maddalena above Montreal. Belal (left) in near-true RIGHT profile, wearing sunglasses and a striped shirt, belt on his shoulder. Best profile: nose line, beard projection, the skin fade, the occipital curve and a thickened right ear.

author: Jay Anderson / Cageside Press
notes: UFC 315 ceremonial weigh-in, front-on, arms spread holding a Palestinian flag. Shows the upper body front, chest and arm hair, a silver chain with pendant, a red wristband on the right wrist and a watch on the left. 711 px wide.

author: Chris Unger / Zuffa LLC (caption credit)
notes: Official weigh-in face-off with Gabriel Bonfim at the Meta APEX. Belal (left) in right profile, shirtless, navy shorts with a red pattern. Small (711 px) but the most recent profile: confirms the head shape, beard and build at fight week.

author: Chris Unger / Zuffa LLC via Getty Images
license: All rights reserved (Getty Images / Zuffa LLC)
notes: In-fight photo (Belal on the right, red Venum shorts with MUHAMMAD down the leg and a Monster Energy logo, red-cuffed gloves; the blue-cuffed fist on his face is Bonfim's). Shows his left side and back: left ear thickening, the back and shoulder build, the hairy forearms, no tattoos. Face is distorted by a punch and there is a fresh cut on the nose bridge; do not use it for the face shape.
